description:
A simplified touch optimized interface for QGIS in the field.


What's Changed
- Fix QFieldCloud project attachment upload queue blocked when trying to upload to cloud projects that have been deleted from the server or cloud projects with which the authenticated user role changed to reader
- Insure that printed layouts have file names that are compatible with QFieldCloud
- Fix 3D geometry overlay heights after zooming the 3D map view not adjusted
- Allow for 1-feature atlas layout prints through the side dashboard to automatically open the resulting PDF when single file mode is turned off
- Improve detection of QGIS project/datasets on app launch
🤖 Android-specific improvements
- Update Android NDK to r29
- Notification handling improvements on Android
Full Changelog: v4.3.5...v4.3.6
